senses.definition: Any of several mechanisms that regulate the periodicity of biological functions, such as the circadian rhythm.
senses.example:
2005 US Department of Health - Your guide to healthy sleep
Your biological clock is actually a tiny bundle of cells in your brain that responds to light signals received through your eyes.

senses.definition: The perceived time limit of human fertility, especially for women, evoking pressure to conceive children before reproductive ability declines with age.
